ZOMBIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}600
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}fires imps to mid-lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}explodes into shower of imps if not destroyed quickly

{FLAVOR}The Imps joined the Order of the Cannon Fraternity, Kappa Pea, and quickly rose through the ranks due to the constant firing of their leadership.
ZOMBIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Shoots Pirate Imps past your defenses. Eventually it can explode and rain down imps.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}It is a fact that everyone loves clowns, and zombies, and therefore clown zombies.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The pointy cone provides extra protection for this jolly fellow.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}It turns out miniature elephants are a much greater challenge to train than the regular-sized ones. This is especially true if the trainer is a zombie and has no mind.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: The bucket-like miniature elephant stand allows this zombie performer to withstand extra damage.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (grinderbox) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases a Carnie Monkey when grinderbox is broken

{FLAVOR}Initially hired to take care of a case involving a runaway monkey, he found himself frustrating a great magician in his chase, and as punishment, Grinderhead Zombie found himself spellbound into a card, sealed away for who knows how long. It's cramped in there, itchy, and the monkey still hasn't learned his lesson. All-in-all it's a net negative.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grinderbox helmet provides spectacular defense against attacks, also houses a monkey for extra pizzazz!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches a Cannonball Imp towards the middle of the lawn

{FLAVOR}Despite recent budget cuts, this cannon show is still possible! Unfortunately at the cost of lacking the needed staying power.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_CANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Launches a daredevil carnie imp high above the crowds.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_COTTONCANDY_BLUE_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws blue cotton candies that boost zombies' speed by 50%

{FLAVOR}"I hate the guy next to me." - Blue Vendor Zombie
Throws blue, speed-boosting cotton candies for zombies to enjoy while they perform.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_COTTONCANDY_PINK_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws pink cotton candies that boost zombies' toughness by 18%

{FLAVOR}Pink is in fashion! A vibrant and playful color! Perfect for carnie visitors and especially for all the awe-inspired imps! Though despite seeing lots of success, he still finds the time to try sabotaging his (very limited) competition, usually by sliding in disgusting veggies in his candy. Only buy stuff from him if you find his effort respectable, capiche?
Throws pink, toughness-boosting cotton candies for zombies to enjoy while they perform.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Carnie Zombie loves the freedom of the open road and would never ever cheat you. He expected that nobody would cheat him either, but those darn carnival games just always seem to get the better of him. One might say spending copius amounts of Zombucks on carnival games in the first place is a poor investment in this economy, but you'd be surprised just how fluffy those rewarded carnival toys are.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A hard and honest worker at a "hard and earnest" carnie.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DOVE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}150
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}1.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}flies over and targets the most recently placed plant

{FLAVOR}Expertly trained to hide in tight spaces and grab objects with utmost precision. However, training their manners is a daunting task, so be patient with their litter.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_DOVE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Quickly flies from the Magician to carry away a plant.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}450
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}breathes fire towards nearby plants every 7 seconds
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguishes flame

{FLAVOR}Always safety-conscious, Firebreather Zombie only breathes fire when there are things nearby that burn easily. That's not all he's confused about, either.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FIREBREATHER_DESCRIPTION_H: Firebreather Zombie... wait for it... breathes fire. And plenty of it!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}In a world filled with supposed wonder, Carnie Flag Zombie has been upset that his iconic phrase "Come one, come all!" always seems to fall on deaf ears. He was tasked to put up various posters in hopes of enticing people to come to the carnival but he suspects they may be achieving the opposite result.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge extravagant "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with barbell
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Carnie Imp Twins when damaged

{FLAVOR}Don't let appearances decieve you, Strongman Gargantuar's got a master's degree in 18th-century French poetry, which is his preferred hobby. He only got convinced to enter the entertainment industry under the promise that he'd get to carry elephants. You can imagine his disappointment upon meeting Carnie Buckethead.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Muscular zombie that's ready to steal the spotlight and put on a show!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700 (helmet) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Cannonball Imp can't keep any of his jobs for long. He always ends up getting fired.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is fired past your defenses, then moves on to Act 2 of his performance.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_SPLIT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Carnie Imp Split is pursuing solo opportunities, as is Carnie Imp Split.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_SPLIT_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Separating Carnie Imp Twins creates two Carnie Imp Splits.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}splits into two imps upon defeat
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage before splitting

{FLAVOR}They're not actually twins, though they are identical.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_IMP_TWINS_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Two imps are generously provided for the price of one.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}500
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}teleports other zombies and himself 1.5 tiles forward
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summoned doves steal plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to magic effects

{FLAVOR}"Now you see my entry, now you       !"
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MAGICIAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Teleports zombies and himself forward using his magic tricks! Also has sneaky doves that'll fly away with your plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MIRROR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}460
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}reflected card projectiles affect plants

{FLAVOR}She remembers this moment as if it was yesterday: her, walking in the hall of mirrors, struck by the gaze, the beauty of which she had never seen before. It truly takes one kind of a face to look this good inside a warped reflection. This story of self-love is as twisted as the funhouse mirror itself.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MIRROR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Carries a mirror that reflects tarot spells back onto plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MONKEY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}1
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes plants with its mug instead of eating

{FLAVOR}Oo-Oo-Aah-AAH!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MONKEY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Once released, monkeys will run at full speed to show off their latest act: "The Baneful Battery!"
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MUSICBOX_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}stuns plants in a 3x3 radius around her
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}releases 3 Mechanical Monkeys on her lane once defeated
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off her windup key
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}music box has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets

{FLAVOR}The story tells of an inventor who had created a mechanical doll so lifelike, that it had smitten one of the youth of a traveling carnival band. The boy decided to pursue her heart and abandon his lover, unaware of the dolls' true nature. He made his way to the place where he sees the doll everyday, only to find she's nothing but a shell. Before he could leave, however, the inventor had trapped him in the building. Several days later, a girl went around town, looking for her lover, to no avail. Back in his lab, Dr. Zomboss cheered and laughed as he witnessed his creation slowly moving to life on its own, the boy nowhere in sight.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_MUSICBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Stuns nearby plants with her soothing music box tunes and has a surprise saved for her final act!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_PRANKSTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}910
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}attacks plants with electric buzzer before throwing dynamites, dealing more damage the longer it's used
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}throws dynamites that deal 900 damage at plants after stopping at the sixth column, priority depends on higher cost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a Carnie Nibbler when defeated

{FLAVOR}Prankster had already been the Zombie that he is nowadays way before the Carnival. His origin is shrouded in rumors. Some say he hides something, believing others can't handle the truth. Another rumor was that he came from a terrible discovery regarding his father. Some even say that he is actually a bloodthirsty vampire. We asked Prankster, but he simply stated that he prefers his origin to be multiple choice.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_PRANKSTER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Throws deadly dynamites towards plants just for some giggles! Prioritizes higher cost plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (stilts) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ignores plants while on stilts instead of eating them
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to most knockback while on stilts

{FLAVOR}At such a towering height, Stiltwalker Zombie has an elevated view of things. He refuses, for example, to buy second-hand milk.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_STILTWALKER_DESCRIPTION_HE: Stiltwalker Zombie's stilts allow him to walk right over most plants.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_BALL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}1
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ignores plants
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}explodes and deals 300 damage to a random plant in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd column

{FLAVOR}Fun for the whole family, these revolutionary toys were patented back in the 16th century and were lovingly stockpiled here for a long while. All they needed was a paint-job and an award winning smile and you're set! Just don't kick them too hard, the Caliginous Carnival team and the Zomboss estate are not liable for any damages. No refunds.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_BALL_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Bounces deep into defenses and explodes and destroys a plant for its final act!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1800
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with new Mallet-Smashing action, dealing 7.5 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}The series 14 Action Gargantuar has been a point of contention due to the specific way in which they were manufactured; in that regardless of how you package them, they will always find a way outside of their box. As you can imagine, this has brought great frustration to both gardeners and collectors alike.
The biggest toy on the market.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_SNIFFER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}750
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.5
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}sniffing does no damage, but helps it block shots for other zombies

{FLAVOR}"If I was a nose, why would I have a nose? Checkmate."
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_SNIFFER_DESCRIPTION_HE: This toy sniffs plants, blocking shots and gives the zombie performers space to put on a show!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_TEDDY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes plants to the left instead of eating
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage to other obstacles
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off its head

{FLAVOR}These were once made to heighten zombie morale and sold as an actual product among zombiekind just so Dr. Zomboss could gain some quick bucks. As one could already guess, his PR had to work overtime after that disaster.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_TEDDY_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Pushes plants across the lawn with its totally fluffy arms.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_TEETH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}330
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.45
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 3 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}A lot of zombies could have really used these in their daily unlives but Zomboss had to be a showoff.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TOY_TEETH_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Shuffles towards plants with quite the presentation with its appetite!
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_BLUE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.135
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops onto the lawn in groups of 2 to 4

{FLAVOR}Working on improving themselves, these talented gymnasts put in years of work to be able to perform these undeath-defying stunts perfectly. All that effort just to be invited to a flimsy place like this with no opportunity to find a better gig. It's quite sad, really.
ZOMBIE_CARNIE_TRAPEZE_BLUE_DESCRIPTION_H: A group of zombies that perform wonderful tricks by landing one by one on a single tile, with style and elegance to boot!
ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Once released onto the lawn chickens run full speed to peck at your brains.
ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_FARMER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons zombie chickens when damaged

{FLAVOR}After publishing the fourth study on Ornithology, and four years of research at the Hadron Collider, Chicken Wrangler Zombie has finally solved the riddle of what came first.
ZOMBIE_CHICKEN_FARMER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Releases a flock of chickens once his baling wire is broken.
ZOMBIE_CHILDRENSDAY_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}Teddy Imp dreams of being a real bear, fetching his favorite snack: honey! His extreme bee allergy gets in the way of such dreams, but who would tell an innocent imp that?
ZOMBIE_CHILDRENSDAY_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Is flown into your defenses, then prowls onwards.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_ARMOR1_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}He might look childish, but- oh who are we kidding. That is clearly a grown zombie stuffed into children's clothing. You ain't fooling us!
His plastic cone gives him twice the amount of protection and entertainment than that of a regular kid zombie.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_ARMOR2_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}He's grown tired of playing in the sand. When he grows up, he wants to explore the world. Zombies might not age, but they can dream.
His bucket makes for great protection, and a noise muffler for all his parent's pointless lectures.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_ARMOR4_ALMANAC_DESCRIPTI:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (legos) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}This lego headwear set is suitable for children aged 5-10. Legohead Zombie just found out that he's actually 11 years old. He's having a hard time coping with this.
Legohead Zombie's carefully assembled headgear playfully provides great head protection.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350 + Imp Child Cargo
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects

{FLAVOR}His dad got trapped on a balloon just like him, and his granddad before that back in the industrial age. It seems to be running in the family.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Imp Child flying with a bunch of balloons. When the balloons are popped, the Imp is set loose into your defense.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_BASIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}He may look like a kid, but try calling him that in a raw online match and you'll get the most ear-piercing sound imaginable.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows low-damage bubbles (bubbles deal 20 damage)

{FLAVOR}He’s called Fishy Imp for many reasons. He carries a fish, he’s done some fishy things and he smells like fish. He also brought a fish to a birthday party and it did not end well.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_CAPTAIN_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Fishy Imps blow a barrage of low-damage bubbles from their toy guns.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a lollipop (350 HP) upon defeat

{FLAVOR}Puberty hit really hard for this zombie. Now he shoulders all the responsibility to guide his friends towards the harsh cruel world of being an adult. Happy 13th Birthday, Jeremy!
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge hyperactive "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_FOOTBALL_MECH_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}pushes plants to the left instead of eating
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 4 times the normal damage to other obstacles

{FLAVOR}Toy Car Imp hates to eat his fruits and vegetables and would rather push them away. He wants to stay young forever and believes there should be a day that celebrates the greatness of being a child. They would call it: Children’s Day.
Pushes plants across the lawn to the left instead of eating.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}5400
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with stick
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}tosses Teddy Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}The alternative to this was wearing an outfit made from pure candy, and that'd be like hanging a big 'EAT ME' sign around these little monsters. Call him whatever you want, but the risk isn't worth it.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_H: The biggest baby of them all.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to poison effects

{FLAVOR}At first you may think there isn't much to this zombie, but if you got to really know him you'd still be correct.
ZOMBIE_CHILDREN_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Is flown into your defenses, then plays onwards.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}The sheriff of these here parts. Please pull over the horse and pull out your driver's license, registration, and proof of brains.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His cowhide cone gives him twice the toughness of a regular cowboy.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}A five-time winner of the temporal chili cook-off. Those Egyptian zombies don't know their chili, but Cowboys love their beans. The more you eat, the more you brains.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His chili pot hat makes him greatly resistant to damage.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (cart) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cart-Head Zombie could probably move a lot faster if he did a handstand and rolled, but he's not thinking that far ahead.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cart-Head Zombie's cart-shaped chapeau provides extra-wheeled head protection.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Cowboy Zombie thinks he's the roughest, toughest, meanest zombie varmint in the west, south and east. He's anxious to test his skills in the central coast region.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge dusty "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Arrows point to the brain on Cowboy Rally's Flag, as if to say, "Hey, everyone, I would like to emphasize this image." It's canny design.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Cowboy Rally Zombie marks the appearance of a sizable stampede of zombies.
ZOMBIE_COWBOY_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with brand
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Bull Rider when damaged

{FLAVOR}Likes candy.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Conehead Peasant is just happy to have a cone over his head. Times are tough, man. He knows a lot of zombies don't even have that.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His stony turret cone makes him twice as tough as normal peasants.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}None of the other zombies seem to understand just how versatile Buckethead Peasant's choice of headwear is. Sure, his bucket makes for a great battle helmet. But just last night, he cooked a truly divine brain stew in it. And next time you see his band, check out what he’s using for a kick drum.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His forged bucket provides great protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1600 (helmet) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Knight Zombie was just as surprised as anyone when Zombie King promoted him. He'd never say this out loud, but he's not sure he deserves the position. He's not sure he has what it takes to wear the armor. But like they say, "Fake it 'til you make it."
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His king appointed helm provides amazing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (tower) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}There is a tale of a beautiful princess locked in a secret tower. This brave, once knighted zombie, managed to find her. His quest, however, was stopped once he fell in love with the tower instead. Now, his hobby of making tower-like headware has completely consumed his unlife. And he lived happily? ever after...
ZOMBIE_DARK_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His medieval tower shaped armor provides astonishing protection from damage.
ZOMBIE_DARK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Someone shouted, "Bring out your undead!" And then Peasant Zombie found himself here. He simply doesn't remember anything that happened before that.
ZOMBIE_DARK_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}torch destroys plants on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish torch

{FLAVOR}If Lost Explorer was transported to Ancient Egypt to become Explorer Zombie, then where does this guy come in? The truth is that there's an entire convoluted multiverse revolved around the Explorers that we'd rather not delve into right now.
ZOMBIE_DARK_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Carries a torch that can instantly destroy your plants and can make a mean howl.
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}They keep telling Peasant Zombie that there is no greater reward than being granted the banner to carry into battle. But when he sees other Peasant Zombies being granted cones, buckets, and even helms, he thinks maybe they're making that up so they don't hurt his feelings.
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge dark "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Peasant Rally Zombie often tells the other peasants that they’ve got to move quick to slay an ogre on the loose. The truth is, he doesn’t know where the ogre is. Could he be the ogre?
ZOMBIE_DARK_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Marks the arrival of a huge dark pile of zombies.
ZOMBIE_DARK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with hammer
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Monk when damaged

{FLAVOR}When Dark Ages Gargantuar wants to find pantaloons that fit him, he has to shop at the "Enormous & Towering" store. He hates it though. It's embarrassing. He just wants to shop for clothes where all the other zombies shop.
ZOMBIE_DARK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Immense zombie who brings the hammer down.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Frankly, Imp Monk Zombie decided to don the robes because of the sweet haircut that went with them.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Summoned past most of your defenses, then shambles onward.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to fire damage

{FLAVOR}Imp Zombie knows he's too old to wear a dragon costume like a kid on Halloween. But he doesn't care. Let the others judge. His spirit animal is a dragon, and he feels closer to his true self when he's dressed like this.
ZOMBIE_DARK_IMP_DRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Spit past most of your defenses, then claws forward.
ZOMBIE_DARK_JUGGLER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}420
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2 (normal), 0.16 (juggling)

{FLAVOR}Oh sure, everyone loves to laugh at Jester Zombie's clownish routines. But what no one knows is that he has a Master of Fine Arts from the Chewliard Performing Arts School. Heck, he's been on stage with some of the finest classical theatre companies this side of the lawn. But sometimes you just gotta go where the paycheck is.
ZOMBIE_DARK_JUGGLER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Returns projectiles that are shot at him.
ZOMBIE_DARK_KING_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000

{FLAVOR}As Shakespeare once wrote, "Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown." And Zombie King couldn't agree more. It is incredibly difficult to get a good night's sleep with a crown on your head. That thing is all kinds of uncomfortable.
ZOMBIE_DARK_KING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Grants knight helms to nearby peasant zombies.
ZOMBIE_DARK_ROBBER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.41
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a large sun on defeat

{FLAVOR}It's true that sun theft is a considered a crime in 9 different states, especially in such a bleak period like the Dark Ages. But he knows that if he ever gets locked up, he won't finish the sent
ZOMBIE_DARK_ROBBER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bandit Zombies carry sun they have stolen within their bags. They also run away after some time.
ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}plants turn back to normal when Wizard Zombie dies

{FLAVOR}All the zombies agree, Wizard Zombie's powers of transmutation are impressive. But what they don't get is ... why sheep? Everyone knows it would be more helpful if the Wizard used his powers to turn plants into, say, more zombies. But yeah, no one is going to say that to his face.
ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2.5 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}For one to become a high ranking wizard, one must take an oath never to eat vegetation. Which is why being a summoner of the dark arts has its perks. For however troublesome that thing on his head might be, at least it makes for a good loophole. Just don't stare at it for too long. It gets grouchy.
ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_H: Dark Summoner Zombies summon four dragon imps around themselves at a time, twice.
ZOMBIE_DARK_WIZARD_VETERAN_VANILLA_DESCR:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}630
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.12
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}plants turn back to normal when Arcane Shepherd Zombie dies

{FLAVOR}Sure, the Arcane Shepherd's newfound magical upgrades are undeniably cool. Some zombies are still doubters about the whole sheep thing, though. He's got more powerful spells that can quickly mutate plants into another living creature, and he's still using it just to create sheep?! They can't deny he's effective though. In the time it takes for any potential doubters to process their thoughts, the Arcane Shepherd can have a whole lawn of plants transformed into sheep. Maybe it'd be best that they stay quiet about their opinion.
Turns plants into passive sheep at a much faster pace than his standard counterpart.
ZOMBIE_DESIRE_EMPEROR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}910
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.175
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}promoted basic zombies gain higher tier armor when they deal 300 damage, bucketheads fully heal instead
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}demoted plants deal half of their damage until Royal Clan Zombie dies

{FLAVOR}Royal Clan Zombie and Zombie King have always been sworn enemies since the day they met. Both rulers of their own lands, making their armies stronger, and being so lazy they've never walked a day in their unlives. How Royal Clan Zombie can stay so fit only boils Zombie King's blood more.
ZOMBIE_DESIRE_EMPEROR_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Promotes zombies to higher rank and demotes plants.
ZOMBIE_DESIRE_SHIKAISEN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^808080^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 Edgest.

{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}670 + 1000 (vase), 355 (after revival)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185, 0.23 (after revival)
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 1.5 times the normal damage after revival
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}drops a vase upon death, spawning a slightly tougher instance of the zombie if not destroyed quickly
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to shrinking

{FLAVOR}After unlife long training, Shikaisen Zombie finally managed to cheat undeath. You may think this means he can live at peace, but he is rather paranoid that someone will come to assassinate him. He has lived most of his unlife fear from zombie society for this reason, but he could not ignore the desire for brains forever.
ZOMBIE_DESIRE_SHIKAISEN_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Drops a vase upon defeat, which will revive them if not destroyed quickly.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Jurassic Conehead Zombie is trying to get the jump on the whole "traffic cone" idea. He figures it'll be a HUGE market in about 150 million years.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cones, or old leftover horns bundled together with string so that they look sort of like a cone, provide some middling protection.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.175

{FLAVOR}The real question, the burning mystery, is: where did he find blue fur for his outfit?
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Crude drawings of buckets provide as much protection as the real thing.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1600 (skull) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16

{FLAVOR}Contrary to his name, Jurassic Fossilhead's fossil head isn't actually a fossil. That skull's maybe a week and a half old, tops.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR3_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Fossil skulls not only provide a huge amount of damage absorption, but are also extremely classy.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (amber) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}If you were to extract DNA from the Amberhead Zombie and combine it with the DNA of a frog, you'd probably be breaking the law at some point.
ZOMBIE_DINO_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Amberhead Zombie's head-engulfing ball of amber provides hardened protection.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_BLUE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1200
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to Jurassic Panic
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to knockback

{FLAVOR}This zombie was looking for new innovative ways of avoiding getting punched around or eaten by dinosaurs. He decided the best way to handle the situation was to become one with them, which is why he put on the get up. So far it seems to be working, but his friends are all hesitant to tell him that it has more to do with his repugnant body odor than his poorly made dinosaur attire.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_BLUE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Jurassic Imposters utilize their wooden masks to fool dinosaurs into not impacting them.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16

{FLAVOR}Jurassic Bully is slow, stupid, and smells bad. But hey, at least he's punctual.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A trudging, damage-resistant zombie who is immune to all knockback.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants and leaves scorched tiles behind which disappear after 25 seconds
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to knockback

{FLAVOR}Somebody tied rocks to Jurassic Rockpuncher's hands. Being unable to remove them (because he had rocks tied to his hands), he was left with no choice but to roll with it.
ZOMBIE_DINO_BULLY_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HE: Jurassic Rockpuncher pummels plants with rocks tied to his hands.
ZOMBIE_DINO_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Jurassic Zombie is NOT primitive. See, he's wearing a tie and everything!
ZOMBIE_DINO_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Regular beard-having zombie from the unimaginable past.
ZOMBIE_DINO_EGGSHELL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}700 (eggshell) + 100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Don’t ask how a Dinosaur had a Zombie as it’s offspring. Seriously, don’t ask. The answer could inflict irreversible brain trauma.
ZOMBIE_DINO_EGGSHELL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: His eggshell, other than making him subjectively cuter, provides some defensive use.
ZOMBIE_DINO_EGGSTEALER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}80
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.55
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}This imp was the one who pioneered the technological advances of imp-kind with the introduction of Egg-Tech. He's to be given a Nobel Prize Award thousands of years from now and actually got two for defying time itself to be there to receive his first one.
ZOMBIE_DINO_EGGSTEALER_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Egg Stealer Imps are sneaky little buggers that speed into the lawn. When defeated, they drop an egg that will hatch into an Eggshell Imp.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He's not only got a flag, but he's also got a can-do attitude and a fierce hunger for success. Success and brains.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge epochal "wave" of highly anachronistic zombies.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}Where did Jurassic Rally Zombie get his fancy new flag? Nobody knows. It's a mystery. The police should look into it. Or maybe we could get a fund together and hire a detective. It's a real puzzle.
ZOMBIE_DINO_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Jurassic Rally Zombie marks the arrival of large group of zombies.
ZOMBIE_DINO_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}5400
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.16
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with bone
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Jurassic Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}Jurassic Gargantuar wonders how there can be zombies millions of years before the advent of humanity. He doesn't let it get in the way of his plant-bashing, though.
ZOMBIE_DINO_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}100
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.3
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 2 times the normal damage

{FLAVOR}This nasty little nipper can make a serious dent in your defenses if left to his own devious devices.
ZOMBIE_DINO_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A weaker, smaller, much more vicious version of the typical Jurassic zombie.
ZOMBIE_DINO_PTERRY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1000 + 1400 (rock)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.145
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes plants with his rock instead of eating, dealing 2 times the normal damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to knockback

{FLAVOR}The zombie and the little dinosaur go way back. They have an inseparable bond that anyone with a pet would envy. How did this come to be? Well, if you're a smart enough cookie, you can put two-and-two together by looking at that rock he's always carrying around.
ZOMBIE_DINO_PTERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Rock Carrier Zombie carries in a rock. When defeated, he will drop the rock, which blocks damage and crushes plants.
ZOMBIE_DISCO_MECH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2000
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}summons Disco Jetpack Zombies

{FLAVOR}After some initial problems with the sideburn suspension system, the Disco-tron 3000 went on to become the shufflin' dance-bot of doom it is today.
ZOMBIE_DISCO_MECH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Drops in disco zombies when dropping the beat.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}You can thank Conehead Ducky Tube for enforcing proper boat traffic regulation in the pool. Just don't tell him the obvious. He even brought a cone and everything, as long as the effort's there.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His unfortunately non-inflatable cone makes him twice as protected for the pool party.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}After getting stranded in one of Ancient Egypt's harshest prophesied droughts due to a portal, he successfully found his way back to the Modern Day and has been looking forward to quenching his thirst by bringing a drinking bucket into the pool, then realized he's a zombie. Ah, the wonders of undead fallacy.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His bucket makes him sturdy enough to take on the backyard splash.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (bricks) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}Bringing a ducky tube inflatable and having a bunch of bricks on your head is quite the contradictory combo. But hey, he's just extra cautious just in case he somehow hits his head on something other than peas in a pool. Better safe than sorry!
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His brick head serves as an exceptional pool safety precaution.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.165 (on land), 0.33 (on water)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}ducky tube allows the zombie to speed up when in water

{FLAVOR}It used to take a certain kind of zombie to be a Ducky Tuber. Unfortunately for Ducky Tube Zombie, times have changed, and now all zombies enjoy the water just fine. He's not really over it yet, but he's trying something new to keep himself relevant. Who knows? Maybe this new Ducky Tubing style might catch on.
ZOMBIE_DUCKYTUBE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: With his inflatable duck-like flotation apparatus, the Ducky Tube Zombie can quickly waddle his way through water with ease.
ZOMBIE_EASTER_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}470
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}fully resistant to sap effects
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each present has 600 HP

{FLAVOR}Was severely disappointed when he found out that Chick Imps don't share the same colors and patterns as the Easter eggs they came out of.
ZOMBIE_EASTER_TROGLOBITE_DESCRIPTION_HEA: Strong zombie that can push presents across the lawn, with extra Springening cheer!
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with sarcophagus
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Imp Mummy when damaged

{FLAVOR}True fact #1: The pyramids were built in an attempt to make Mummified Gargantuar seem small. It didn't work. True fact #2: The Sphinx isn't missing its nose... that is the face of... Gargantuar.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Massive zombie from a royal line of mummies.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Imp Mummy prefers to laze around the tomb, hop up on the urns, and scratch at the sarcophagi. The sound of him coughing up a hairball is one you will never forget.
ZOMBIE_EGYPT_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Thrown over most of your defenses, then slinks onward.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_8BIT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190 (can come with cone (+ 370) or bucket (+ 1100))
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Being made out of light and positional co-ordinates has no effect on this erzatz zombie’s ravenous hunger for tangy brains.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_8BIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pixelated zombie generated by super cool arcade machine. Comes in regular, cone and bucket flavors.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490 + 600 (arcade cabinet)
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19

{FLAVOR}When it’s a choice between quarters for games and quarters for laundry, Arcade Zombie is prepared to make the ultimate stinky sacrifice.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARCADE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Pushes an arcade cabinet that spits out 8-Bit Zombies.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Neon Conehead Zombie used to be a big believer in de-evolution, but then he forgot what it meant.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Cones provide protection and focus the sound of righteous tunes.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Neon Buckethead Zombie had to go all the way to the dump to find a headband he really liked.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Buckets absorb damage because that’s just what they do.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (speaker) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He can't remember what exactly happened. A wild night at Impunk's place and a couple of brain drinks make you do some berserk things you usually regret in the morning.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: His head-encasing speaker protects him greatly from damage, and has also busted his eardrums.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BASS_BASIC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}850 (speaker) + 270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speaker blasts out shockwaves every few seconds, dealing 10 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}speaker blasts out sonic blasts at range, dealing 1000 damage

{FLAVOR}With a legendary discography under his belt, Bassist Zombie had no trouble mashing with the monsters of the musical world. From the Jiangshi of China to the Space Ogres of Mars, he's rocked and rolled with the best of them. However, he's been advised to tour locally by his agents following a recent pyrotechnic disaster during Brain-in-a-Jar's keyboard solo. Let it be known that despite what the media claims about deliberate sabotage, he didn't start the fire.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BASS_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_H: Drops into your lawn with a speaker to send shockwaves.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}turns on his boom box for 8 seconds after reaching the sixth column
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}boom box has no effect on ground plants and Phat Beets

{FLAVOR}Boombox Zombie doesn’t want to buy, sell or process anything; he just really wants to consume your brains.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BOOMBOX_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Holds aloft a boom box that tranquilizes all plants with its heartfelt tunes.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24 (normal), 0.35 (jamming)
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}kicks zombies 1.5 tiles forward when jamming

{FLAVOR}Delivers only the freshest moves at bargain basement prices.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_BREAKDANCER_DESCRIPTION_: Kicks zombies forward when transported by the power of rap.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}He's cutting down on his head-banging so as not to bang his head clean off.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185

{FLAVOR}Fluorescent colors and little yellow plastic strips are the marks of a truly hip, groundbreaking new style of zombie wave flag.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge mixtape-making "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_FLAG_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4

{FLAVOR}He found the flag at the attic of his old man's house. A little dry and worn out, but it does the job when it comes to making everyone at the party go insane, follow you to raid the nearest neighbor's house, and consume his cerebrum.
Marks the arrival of a massive headbangin' army of zombies.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with guitar
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}bashes sonic blast when metal music plays, dealing 1000 damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Impunk when damaged

{FLAVOR}Hair Metal Gargantuar only knows one chord, but you'd better believe he'll play it all night and then some.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}490
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.19
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}instant-kill any plant on contact when jamming

{FLAVOR}Glitter Zombie inspires zombies everywhere to boogie their brains out, whether it's just one moment or maybe forever, or at least until the lights come on and they're kicking everybody out.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_GLITTER_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Trails glamorous rainbows that protect zombies behind her when she's feeling the beat.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22

{FLAVOR}Impunk’s lyrics have been described as "banal," "incoherent," and "totally expressive of the Zompunk movement at its finest."
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tossed past most of your defenses, then rocks out to your detriment.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_MC_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}spins his microphone in a 3x3 area, dealing 2000 damage when jamming

{FLAVOR}MC Zom-B doesn’t want you to know it, but his fancy bling is really just gold-plated zinc he got from his grandma.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_MC_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Spins microphone to damage nearby plants when he's dropping his sick, sick rhymes.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}Punk Zombie’s piercings represent his individuality and his belief in personal freedom, or maybe just that he fell face-first into a sewing machine.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Moshes plants back a space when his jam is playing.
ZOMBIE_EIGHTIES_PUNK_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}900
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.44
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}Magnet-shroom can pull off his head

{FLAVOR}The other zombies just don't get him. They always say "What's up with Goth Punk Zombie? He looks so emotionally distant all the time." It's not that he's constantly down or anything. It's just that, as a zombie, he's physically incapable of portraying emotions.
Goth Punk Zombies rock out to only the saddest of tunes.
ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}torch destroys plants on contact
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}cold attacks extinguish torch

{FLAVOR}His impressive friendly mutton chops have always kept food in them for weeks, making sure his explorations are filled with snacks.
ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Carries a torch that can instantly destroy your plants.
ZOMBIE_EXPLORER_VETERAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.5
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}deals 1.5 times the normal damage
